game.name: Riftbound
game.description: Riftbound is a trading card game.

vocabulary.means: It names the text printed in a card's own text box.

textFields.describes: the effect box on a gear card, holding the text the equipped unit gains

statFields.describes: The Might a gear card grants to the unit that holds it. Only a gear card carries this value.
The Energy cost to play the card.
The Power cost to play the card, which is paid alongside Energy.

answer: A card's text, stats, cost, and how named cards interact.
Whether a card is banned or restricted, and any change to its printed text.
Defined terms, keywords, and ability definitions.
Rule structure: parent rules, sub-rules, related rules, and rulebook sections.
Update notes and recent rules changes that the tools return.

extraGuidance: A gear card's `card_text` often holds only its EQUIP line. What the equipped unit gains is in `effect_text`, and the Might it grants is in `might_bonus`. Read all three before you say what a gear card does, and never conclude from `card_text` alone that a card has no such text.
A banned-and-restricted entry and a card-change entry each carry the card's image path, so you can link the card from them without a separate card lookup.
